editorial_intro: Rajkumar Hirani's OTT debut and a Ryan Gosling sci-fi thriller lead the week — plus Sunny Deol's courtroom drama lands Thursday.

picks.title: Pritam and Pedro
picks.synopsis: Rajkumar Hirani's OTT debut pairs a veteran cop (Arshad Warsi) with a tech-savvy hacker (Vir Hirani) to crack a high-profile kidnapping tied to a cybercrime ring. Vikrant Massey co-stars in this six-episode series.
picks.why_watch: Hirani's first streaming project — charming buddy chemistry and a surprisingly tight cyber-thriller

picks.title: Dadi Ki Shaadi
picks.synopsis: When Tony's grandmother announces she wants to remarry, his wedding plans spiral into chaos. Ashwiny Iyer Tiwari directs this Punjabi family comedy starring Neetu Kapoor and Kapil Sharma.
picks.why_watch: Neetu Kapoor and Kapil Sharma together — heartwarming and genuinely funny family drama

picks.title: Mollywood Times
picks.synopsis: An aspiring filmmaker's obsession with making the perfect horror film blurs the line between ambition and reality in this psychological dark comedy. Naslen leads the cast in a sharp look at indie cinema's absurdities.
picks.why_watch: IMDB 7.4 — if you liked CU Soon or Nayattu, this meta-Malayalam gem is for you

picks.title: Muthassi
picks.synopsis: Set in a remote Tulu village on the Kerala-Karnataka border, a mother returns to her ancestral home only to find an ancient demonic entity possessing her young son. Seven episodes of folklore-rooted horror.
picks.why_watch: South Indian horror done right — atmospheric, folklore-driven, and genuinely creepy

picks.title: Ikka
picks.synopsis: Sunny Deol's major OTT debut is a high-stakes courtroom drama reuniting him with Akshaye Khanna nearly three decades after Border. Directed by Siddharth P. Malhotra. Drops July 10.
picks.why_watch: Sunny Deol and Akshaye Khanna back together after Border — this one's been buzzing for months

picks.title: Karakkam
picks.synopsis: Two friends accidentally unleash a group of spirits during a New Year's Eve prank, setting off a chaotic supernatural adventure in this Malayalam musical horror comedy.
picks.why_watch: Musical horror comedy — yes, that's a genre now, and it works

picks.title: Project Hail Mary
picks.synopsis: Based on Andy Weir's bestseller, Ryan Gosling stars as a lone astronaut who wakes up on a spaceship with no memory, tasked with saving Earth from an extinction-level threat. From the author of The Martian.
picks.why_watch: The Martian author's next story with Ryan Gosling — smart, gripping sci-fi at its best

picks.title: Silo Season 3
picks.synopsis: Rebecca Ferguson returns as Juliette Nichols in the new season, re-entering the silo with no memory of recent events. A parallel storyline reveals how the silos first came into existence centuries earlier.
picks.why_watch: One of the best sci-fi shows running — the mystery only deepens

picks.title: Enola Holmes 3
picks.synopsis: Millie Bobby Brown returns as Sherlock's younger sister. When Sherlock disappears on the day of Enola's wedding, she's drawn into a mystery that uncovers a larger conspiracy.
picks.why_watch: Perfect weekend watch with the family — fun, smart, and beautifully shot

picks.title: Sparks of Tomorrow
picks.synopsis: Set in a steam-powered Kyoto, a grieving boy and a determined girl search for a mysterious electrical catalogue that could change their lives. A visually stunning fantasy anime.
picks.why_watch: Gorgeous steampunk anime — if you loved Spirited Away's world-building, give this a shot
